name: stickerforge
description: Turns one character image into hundreds of print-ready transparent PNG stickers.

interface.shortDescription: Transparent print-ready sticker packs from one image
interface.longDescription: Plans concepts, checks duplicates, runs a pilot, batch-generates, gates alpha and fake checkerboard backgrounds, retries failures twice, and exports a contact sheet.
defaultPrompt: Use $stickerforge to turn my character image into a sticker pack.
